corpus.label: career_family_balance
corpus.rawText: Should I accept a remote promotion or keep my current local role?

options.title: Accept the remote promotion
benefits: It would advance my career faster.
It would let me build stronger leadership skills.
costs: It would reduce daily time with my family.
It could make me feel isolated.
It may add pressure and longer hours.

options.title: Keep the local role
benefits: It preserves a stable family routine.
It keeps my stress level manageable.
It lets me stay close to friends and relatives.
costs: It may slow my career growth.
It keeps my salary almost unchanged.
It may feel like I avoided a useful challenge.

corpus.label: career_family_balance
corpus.rawText: Should I join a demanding startup or remain in my predictable job?

options.title: Join the startup
benefits: It could create major career upside.
It would teach me new product skills.
It may give me more ownership at work.
costs: It would take evenings away from my partner.
It could make my schedule unstable.

options.title: Remain in the predictable job
benefits: It keeps my home life reliable.
It protects my health and sleep.
costs: It may limit my professional growth.
It gives me fewer chances to lead.

corpus.label: money_family_support
corpus.rawText: Should I lend savings to my sibling or keep the money for my own emergency fund?

options.title: Lend the money
benefits: It would help my sibling through a hard period.
It matches my sense of responsibility.
costs: It may create resentment if repayment is delayed.
It could make my own plans less secure.

options.title: Keep the emergency fund
benefits: It keeps my rent and bills safe.
It avoids mixing money with family tension.
costs: It may leave my sibling unsupported.

corpus.label: money_family_support
corpus.rawText: Should I pay for my parent's medical bill or keep saving for my apartment deposit?

options.title: Pay the medical bill
benefits: It would protect my parent's health.
It shows loyalty to my family.
costs: It uses most of my savings.
It may make me financially dependent longer.

options.title: Keep saving for the deposit
benefits: It keeps my financial plan on track.
It avoids taking on new debt.
costs: It leaves my parent with a serious burden.
It could make me feel guilty.

corpus.label: health_work_boundary
corpus.rawText: Should I take sick leave or keep working through exhaustion?

options.title: Take sick leave
benefits: It gives my body time to recover.
It reduces the chance of making mistakes.
costs: It could delay an important project.
It may make me look less committed.

options.title: Keep working
benefits: It shows reliability to my manager.
costs: It leaves no time to rest.

corpus.label: health_work_boundary
corpus.rawText: Should I accept overtime this month or protect my recovery routine?

options.title: Accept overtime
benefits: It would help the team meet a deadline.
It could improve my reputation at work.
costs: It leaves less time for exercise.

options.title: Protect the recovery routine
benefits: It protects my energy for the long term.
It helps me stay emotionally stable.
costs: It could make me seem less ambitious.

corpus.label: comfort_growth_goal
corpus.rawText: Should I spend evenings learning a language or keep relaxing after work?

options.title: Learn the language
benefits: It supports a long-term personal goal.
It expands my future travel and work options.
costs: It reduces easy rest after work.
It may feel frustrating at first.

options.title: Keep relaxing
costs: It may become a habit of avoidance.
It gives me fewer future opportunities.

corpus.label: comfort_growth_goal
corpus.rawText: Should I start morning fitness training or keep sleeping later?

options.title: Start training
costs: It removes the comfort of sleeping late.
It will be hard in the first weeks.

options.title: Keep sleeping later
costs: It may reduce my sense of progress.
It can leave me less fit over time.

corpus.label: career_skill_choice
corpus.rawText: Should I choose a management course or a technical course for my career?

options.title: Management course
benefits: It may help me get promoted.
costs: It may not fit my current tasks.
It costs a lot of money.

options.title: Technical course
benefits: It helps with current engineering work.
costs: It may be narrower for future roles.
It still requires time and tuition.

corpus.label: family_location_choice
corpus.rawText: Should I visit my parents this weekend or attend my friend's celebration?

options.title: Visit my parents
costs: It means missing my friend's event.

options.title: Attend the celebration
benefits: It brings joy and social connection.
costs: It could make me feel guilty.

corpus.label: security_adventure
corpus.rawText: Should I take a safe planned vacation or go on a spontaneous adventure trip?

options.title: Adventure trip
benefits: It gives a sense of freedom.
costs: It may cost more than expected.
It could be stressful if plans fail.

corpus.label: ethics_loyalty
corpus.rawText: Should I report a coworker's mistake or stay silent to protect the relationship?

options.title: Report the mistake
benefits: It may prevent harm to customers.
costs: It could damage trust with my coworker.
It may create conflict at work.
It could make me look disloyal.

options.title: Stay silent
benefits: It gives the coworker a chance to fix it privately.

queries.label: career_family_balance
queries.rawText: Should I take a higher-status job that reduces family time or stay in a calmer role?

options.title: Take the higher-status job
benefits: It would build valuable leadership experience.
costs: It leaves less time at home.
It could make my week feel unstable.

options.title: Stay in the calmer role
costs: It could feel like avoiding growth.

queries.label: money_family_support
queries.rawText: Should I use my savings to help a relative or keep the money for my own security?

options.title: Keep the money
benefits: It keeps my plans on schedule.

queries.label: health_work_boundary
queries.rawText: Should I rest to recover or push through work for an important deadline?

options.title: Rest to recover
benefits: It lowers the risk of burnout.

options.title: Push through work
benefits: It avoids handing work to others.
costs: It leaves little room for recovery.

queries.label: comfort_growth_goal
queries.rawText: Should I give up easy evenings for a long-term self-improvement goal?

options.title: Work on the goal
benefits: It creates a sense of progress.
costs: It may be frustrating at first.
